pages.title: The Current Flows
pages.text: Restore a Broken Dinamo and power a real Plasma Lamp through its Tesla Network.

pages.title: The Current Flows
pages.text: Pillars and extra lamps expand the network already working instead of replacing it with a free generator.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Dinamo requests planks, Homunculus, iron and Tesla Coil in stages confirmed with Wrench. Link native nodes, choose top pillars with equal heights and use relays to extend range.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Supply Oak Planks, Homunculus, Iron Ingots and Tesla Coil to Broken Dinamo, using Wrench at the requested stages. Native repair messages describe confirmation before consuming material stacks and a staged reconstruction route.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use Wrench to link Tesla nodes, select the top Voltaic Pillar and build equal-height pillar columns. Self-links and overlong connections are rejected; Voltaic Relay extends the connection chain.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Power Plasma Lamps through Tesla Coil and linked network blocks, or use Recall Platforms. The native tooltips distinguish lighting, continuous current and inter-platform teleportation.
